text: Figure 7.14: Dependency resolution during state change [SWS_EM_02245] Dependency resolution during state change Upstream requirements: RS_EM_00101 ⌈Execution Management shall perform Execution Dependency resolution against the Processes that are configured for RequestedState.⌋ Please note that [SWS_EM_02245] doesn’t bring new functionality to state transition. It merely ensures that [SWS_EM_02251] and [SWS_EM_01066] are performed on Process A, before [SWS_EM_01066] is performed on Process B. If this order is not ensured then [SWS_EM_02245] could not be satisfied as Process A will be a Process that is configured for CurrentState and not for RequestedState.
